What to include in your message

    About

    About ROYALTY

    ROYALTY is an owner-operated business based in Lephalale, serving residential and business customers. You have one point of contact to discuss the job, arrange access and ask questions about the work.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Is the estimate the final price?

    No. The online estimate is a guide based on the work you select. The final price is confirmed after the requirements have been reviewed, before work starts.

    What does the price range mean?

    The lower figure is the itemised total. The higher figure adds about 15% in case parts, access or site conditions turn out different from what the estimate assumes.

    How do I save or share my quote?

    Open your quote and choose Download PDF, then select Save as PDF in your browser’s print window. Choose Print for a paper copy, or send your estimate details on WhatsApp.

    What is the travel fee?

    Jobs in Lephalale town, Onverwacht and Marapong have no travel fee. For farms and lodges further out, a fixed fee per trip applies, based on the distance.

    Do you work with businesses?

    Yes. The same services are available to companies and business premises, as well as homes, farms and lodges. For larger jobs, send the location and scope of work so the requirements can be reviewed.

    Can you come urgently?

    I work alone, so I take one job at a time. Choose Urgent in the estimator or call me. I will tell you honestly if I can come the same or next day.
